scripts.check: npm run generated:generate --workspace @tgbot/shared && node scripts/check.mjs && npm run typecheck && node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm run test:runtime
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=tgbot-apk-webui --branch=preview
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=tgbot-apk-webui --branch=main
scripts.typecheck: npm run types:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.config.mjs --project=chromium
scripts.test:browser:webkit: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.config.mjs --project=webkit
